full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white night street photograph looks down a rough empty lane from a low, slightly tilted position. The paved foreground is broad and uneven, with dark stains, small scattered scraps, and a raised curb running along the right wall. The lane narrows into a deeper cluster of buildings and trees at the middle left. A tall utility pole stands near the left edge, and wires stretch diagonally overhead. Two bright streetlamps bloom into white flares high above the street, one near the upper left and another farther away at the center. Their glare erases some detail but also throws irregular patches of light across the ground. The right side is dominated by a tall wall covered in layered, distressed posters, partial characters, and scraped paper. One larger poster near the lower right shows the printed face of a short-haired woman, dark and pale tones broken by wear. A rectangular sign above it carries Japanese characters, but the blur and limited resolution prevent reliable transcription. Small distant shop fronts or vehicles are suggested where the lane opens at left, yet no nearby pedestrian appears. The sky and deep alley recesses are almost black, while the wall and road flicker through coarse gray grain. The camera angle makes vertical lines lean and lets the right wall press close to the viewer, emphasizing a restless urban perspective. Grain, blown highlights, and smeared edge detail are part of the image rather than defects to clean away. The photograph holds a charged quiet: there is little visible action, but the bright lamps, empty pavement, crowded printed wall, and tilted geometry make the street feel immediate and unsettled.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白夜街照片从低而略斜的机位望向一条粗糙、空旷的巷道。宽阔前景路面不平，有深色污迹、零散碎屑，右侧墙边一道路缘向远处延伸。巷道在中左部收进更深的建筑和树影。一根高电杆立在左缘附近，电线从头顶斜向穿过。两盏明亮路灯在街上方炸成白色光晕，一盏靠左上，一盏更远、靠近中央。强光抹去部分细节，却也在地面投下不规则亮块。右侧由高墙占据，墙上层叠着旧化海报、局部文字和刮损纸张。右下附近一张较大的海报印有一位短发女子的脸，深浅色调被磨损打断。其上方长方形招牌有日文字符，但模糊和有限分辨率不足以可靠誊写。巷道左侧较开处隐约有远店面或车辆，却没有近处行人。天空和深巷凹处几乎纯黑，墙与路面则在粗重灰颗粒中闪烁。机位角度让竖线倾斜，让右墙逼近观者，强化不安定的都市透视。颗粒、过曝亮点和边缘拖糊是图像的一部分，不应被清理掉。照片抓住一种紧绷的安静：可见动作极少，刺眼灯光、空路面、拥挤印刷墙和倾斜几何却让街道显得即时而躁动。
style_prompt_en: Rough high-contrast black-and-white street photography with assertive grain, tilted perspective, and hard nocturnal light. Let dark sky and recesses remain nearly black while lamps bloom into blown white halos; preserve the abrupt transition between them. Pavement, walls, and printed surfaces should carry grime, abrasion, paper layers, and irregular tonal noise. A low camera and leaning verticals create an urgent spatial feeling, with the foreground opening wide before narrowing into darkness. Secondary graphic fragments can remain partly illegible and weathered, functioning as texture rather than clean typography. Do not over-polish the image: coarse grain, blurred edges, and uneven exposure are central to its raw photographic character. The mood is restless, solitary, and urban, made from light and surface rather than a posed figure or explicit event.
style_prompt_zh: 粗粝高反差黑白街头摄影采用强烈颗粒、倾斜透视与坚硬夜间光。天空和凹处近乎纯黑，路灯却炸成过曝白晕，保留两者之间突兀的转换。路面、墙体与印刷表面带污垢、磨痕、层叠纸张和不规则明暗噪点。低机位和歪斜竖线创造紧迫空间感，前景宽阔展开，随后收进黑暗。次要图形碎片可以部分不可读且旧化，作为肌理而非干净字体存在。画面不应过度修饰：粗颗粒、模糊边缘与不均匀曝光是其原始摄影性格的核心。情绪躁动、孤独、都市化，由光和表面构成，而非摆拍人物或明确事件。
theme_en: A grainy high-contrast black-and-white night street with glaring lamps and weathered posters
theme_zh: 一条颗粒粗重、反差强烈的黑白夜街，灯光刺眼，墙上贴着磨旧海报
name: Daido Moriyama
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
